name: grid-template-areas
desc: Names grid cells with strings so items can be placed by area name. Each string is a row, each word a column, and a dot leaves a cell empty.
body:
Every row string must name the same number of columns, and a named area must form a rectangle. A typo in grid-area silently places the item in the first free cell.

The strings are layout, not content. Screen readers still follow the DOM order, so keep the markup in a reading order that makes sense.

name: grid-auto-flow
desc: Controls how automatically placed items fill the grid. dense backfills holes left by larger items, which changes the visual order.
body: dense reorders only the paint position. Focus order stays in the DOM, so a keyboard user can move in a different sequence than the eye follows. Use it for image walls, not for forms.

name: grid-auto-rows
desc: Sizes rows created by the implicit grid, meaning rows no template declared. Useful when items are added without a known count.

name: subgrid
desc: Makes a grid item inherit the track lines of its parent grid. Nested content then aligns to the outer columns without repeating sizes.

name: justify-self
desc: Aligns one grid item along the inline axis, inside its own grid area. Flex items ignore it.

name: align-self
desc: Overrides align-items for a single item on the cross axis. In a flex row that is vertical placement, in a grid cell it is the block axis.

name: justify-items
desc: Sets the default inline axis alignment for every item in a grid container. One item can override it with justify-self.

name: align-content
desc: Spreads the tracks of a multi line flex or grid container along the cross axis. It does nothing when the tracks already fill the container.

name: flex-flow
desc: Shorthand for flex-direction and flex-wrap. row wrap is the common base for a responsive toolbar.

name: column-count
desc: Flows content into newspaper style columns. column-width sets a target width and lets the browser choose the count.

name: column-rule
desc: Draws a line between multi column boxes. It sits in the middle of column-gap and takes no layout space.

name: inline-size and block-size
desc: Logical width and height that follow writing mode. inline-size is width in a normal left to right document, block-size is height.

name: margin-inline
desc: Sets the start and end margin on the inline axis. margin-inline auto centres a fixed width block, the same as the left and right auto pair.

name: @container
desc: Styles children by the size of their container instead of the viewport. The parent must declare container-type first.
body:
A container query answers the component question: is there room here, inside this column or sidebar. A media query answers the page question. Components reused in several widths need the first one.

container-type: inline-size also creates containment, so the element no longer sizes itself from its content. That is why a card wrapper is a safer container than the card itself.

name: @font-face
desc: Loads a custom font file and gives it a family name. Each weight and style needs its own block.

name: text-overflow
desc: Adds an ellipsis when text overflows its box. It only works with overflow hidden or clip and white-space nowrap on a single line.

name: overflow-wrap
desc: Allows a long word or URL to break when it would otherwise overflow. break-word is the older value with a similar visual effect.

name: text-shadow
desc: Draws a shadow behind glyphs: offset x, offset y, blur, colour. It follows the text shape and costs no layout.

name: text-indent
desc: Indents the first line of a block. A negative value plus matching padding produces a hanging indent.

name: font-style
desc: Selects an italic or oblique face, or keeps text upright. Oblique accepts an angle in fonts that support it.

name: font-variant
desc: Turns on typographic variants such as small caps. font-variant-numeric controls figure width in aligned columns.

name: text-underline-offset
desc: Moves the underline away from the baseline so descenders stay readable. text-decoration-thickness sets the line weight.

name: writing-mode
desc: Changes the flow from horizontal to vertical. It flips the meaning of the inline and block axes for every logical property.

name: hyphens
desc: Lets the browser break words with a hyphen at line ends. It needs a lang attribute on the element or an ancestor to choose a dictionary.

name: tab-size
desc: Sets how wide a tab character renders, mostly inside pre and textarea. A number counts spaces, a length is absolute.

name: rgb() and hsl()
desc: Builds a colour from channels. rgb and hsl accept a slash alpha, and modern browsers also accept oklch and lab.

name: currentColor
desc: Resolves to whatever color the element has. It keeps borders, icons and underlines in sync with one declaration.

name: color-scheme
desc: Declares which colour schemes an element supports, so form controls, scrollbars and the canvas pick matching defaults.

name: accent-color
desc: Recolours the browser drawn parts of checkboxes, radios, range sliders and progress bars. One line instead of custom widgets.

name: mix-blend-mode
desc: Blends an element with what is painted under it. It works on the element as a whole, not on single colours.

name: border-image
desc: Paints a border from an image or gradient, sliced into nine regions. The number after the source is the slice.

name: outline-offset
desc: Pushes the outline away from the border box. A negative value pulls it inside, where it can sit on the content.

name: border-style
desc: Picks the line style per side: solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset, outset or none. none hides the width without removing it.

name: background-attachment
desc: Keeps a background fixed to the viewport while content scrolls, or lets it scroll with its element. Fixed can hurt scrolling on mobile.

name: background-clip
desc: Limits painting of the background to the text glyphs or to the padding and content boxes. With transparent text it makes gradient text.

name: background-blend-mode
desc: Blends the background layers of one element with each other. It is separate from mix-blend-mode, which blends the element with the page.

name: multiple background layers
desc: Comma separated layers paint front to back: the first layer is on top. Each layer can set its own position and size.

name: backdrop-filter
desc: Filters what shows through a translucent element, the frosted glass effect. Without a transparent background there is nothing to blur.

name: clip-path
desc: Cuts the painted shape to a polygon, circle, ellipse or path. The element keeps its layout box, only the visible part changes.
body:
A clipped element still receives pointer events only inside the visible shape, but a focus ring drawn outside the cut disappears. Keep focusable controls away from the clipped edge or draw the ring inside.

clip-path on a parent also clips positioned children, including dropdowns that open outside the box.

name: mask-image
desc: Hides parts of an element with a mask image: opaque areas stay, transparent areas are removed. It fades edges without touching layout.

name: position: sticky
desc: Sticks an element at a threshold while its scrolling ancestor moves, then stops at the ancestor edge. A top, right, bottom or left value is required.

name: inset
desc: Shorthand for top, right, bottom and left. inset 0 stretches an absolutely positioned element over its containing block.

name: transition-timing-function
desc: Shapes the speed curve of a transition. ease-out suits entrances, linear only continuous motion, steps sprite frames.

name: @keyframes
desc: Defines named animation steps that animation-name runs. from and to are 0% and 100%, and intermediate percentages are allowed.
body:
Animate transform and opacity when possible. Those two can run on the compositor without layout, while width, height and top force work on every frame.

A keyframe name in @keyframes is case sensitive in CSS and must not be quoted in the animation shorthand.

name: animation-fill-mode
desc: Keeps the values of the first or last keyframe outside the animation. Without it the element snaps back to its own styles.

name: will-change
desc: Hints which properties will animate so the browser can prepare layers early. On many elements it costs memory and slows the page.

name: scroll-behavior
desc: Makes programmatic and anchor scrolling animate instead of jump. Respect prefers-reduced-motion, because smooth motion can cause nausea.

name: scroll-snap-type
desc: Makes a scroll container snap to child points. The container sets the axis and strictness, children set scroll-snap-align.

name: scroll-margin-top
desc: Offsets where an element lands when scrolled into view by an anchor or scrollIntoView. It fixes links hidden under a sticky header.

name: perspective
desc: Adds depth to 3D children of the element: smaller values exaggerate the effect. perspective-origin moves the vanishing point.

name: 3D transforms
desc: Moves and rotates on three axes. The z value only shows with perspective on an ancestor, and 3D transforms can blur text.

name: backface-visibility
desc: Hides the reverse side of a rotated element. Two stacked faces with this property make the classic card flip.

name: @media print
desc: Styles that apply only on paper or PDF. Hide navigation and forms, then let the text use the full width with readable contrast.

name: break-inside
desc: Controls where a printed page may split. break-inside avoid keeps a card or row whole, break-before page starts a new sheet.

name: print-color-adjust
desc: Asks the browser to keep backgrounds and colours in print. By default printers drop backgrounds to save ink.

name: :focus-visible
desc: Matches keyboard focus and skips the ring on a mouse click. It keeps focus obvious for keyboard users without the click ring on buttons.

name: @media (forced-colors: active)
desc: Applies in Windows high contrast mode, where the system replaces colours. Use system colour keywords and keep borders visible.

name: visually hidden text
syntax: .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
desc: Hides content from sight while keeping it for screen readers. Use it for labels and skip links, never with display none.

name: caret-color
desc: Sets the colour of the text cursor in inputs and editable areas. It does not change the selection highlight.

name: ::selection
desc: Styles the highlighted text after a drag or Ctrl+A. Only colour, background and text shadow apply.

name: ::placeholder
desc: Styles the placeholder text of inputs and textareas. Only a small set of properties applies, and Firefox lowers opacity by default.

name: ::marker
desc: Styles the list bullet or number. Only font, colour and content apply, so background and padding are ignored.

name: CSS counters
desc: Numbers elements with generated counters through counter-reset, counter-increment and content. It numbers nested sections without manual text.
